integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for math/0108133 lists version 1 on 2001-08-20.
integrity.formula_basis: The full archival text gives both the complex Grassmannian degree formula and the nonzero real Wronski degree formula.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The archival anchor is submitted under Algebraic Geometry and lists MSC 14P99, 14N10, 14N15, and 14M15.

scientific_limitations: The comparison is restricted to the nonzero real-degree branch a+b odd.
Only the two-adic valuation is asserted; odd-prime valuations need not agree.
The real degree is used in absolute value, so orientation sign choices are irrelevant.
An unindexed sign-imbalance or representation-theory source could contain the same short valuation identity.
title: Exact two-primary agreement between real and complex Wronski degrees
